newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear to close Jamaica factory.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear to close Jamaica factory.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. said on Friday that Goodyear Jamaica Ltd. is closing its Morant Bay facility on the Caribbean island immediately, affecting 148 salaried and hourly workers, Goodyear said.
Goodyear attributed the move to the plant's small size, lower costs elsewhere and the tire maker's ability to service Jamaica from more efficient sources.
Goodyear, based in Akron, Ohio, said it plans to maintain a strong sales presence in Jamaica.
Goodyear Jamaica has not decided what to do with the facility but is in talks with officials about future potential uses for it, the company said.
Displaced workers may be eligible for benefits under Jamaican law and under the company's employee benefit plans, it said.
Goodyear's stock edged up 37.5 cents to $54.50 in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
